description: A bright yellow tennis ball is in front of a white corner backdrop on a tabletop, with a left hand visible near the bottom and the right hand resting off to the side. The left hand tosses the ball upward toward the corner wall, then moves down and forward to catch and hold the ball again in the palm, subtly rotating it as it settles; the right hand stays mostly still and does not touch the ball, so the ball remains a left-hand object after the catch.
